results.snippet: That message is PowerShell blocking scripts by policy. The quickest fix is to relax the policy only for the current terminal and then activate your venv.

results.title: r/learnpython on Reddit: Script execution is deactivated on this computer
results.snippet: In .venv/Scripts folder there are two active scripts; Actiave.ps1 (for PowerShell) and activate.bat (for CMD). By default, Windows PowerShell script execution is blocked. So, if you are trying to run Activate.ps1 in PowrShell you get this error.

results.title: Solution to "Running Scripts Is Disabled On This System" Error On PowerShell
results.snippet: This error happens because the venv\Scripts\activate command tries to run the Activate.ps1 PowerShell script to activate the virtual environment on your system.
